**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 19:07  
[FACT] User has been making their own energy balls with oats, peanut butter, and honey.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy snack ideas to curb afternoon cravings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Energy balls are a great snack and the assistant provided new healthy snack ideas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested snacks include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fresh Fruit and Nut Butter Wraps: Spread almond butter, cashew butter, or sunflower seed butter on a rice cake or whole-grain tortilla, topped with sliced fresh fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Roasted Chickpeas: Spice up chickpeas with olive oil, salt, and seasonings, then roast until crispy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Yogurt Parfait: Layer Greek yogurt with fresh berries, granola, and chia seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Veggie Sticks with Hummus: Dip raw or roasted veggies in hummus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Trail Mix: Mix nuts, seeds, and dried fruits, optionally adding dark chocolate chips or cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Edamame: Steam or boil soybeans, season with sea salt and chili powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Cottage Cheese and Fresh Fruit: Combine cottage cheese with sliced peaches, berries, or bananas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Avocado Toast: Toast whole-grain bread, mash avocado, and season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Protein Smoothie: Blend fruits, yogurt, and milk or protein powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Kale Chips: Bake kale leaves with olive oil and seasonings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Hard-Boiled Eggs: Boil eggs for a protein-rich snack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Apple Slices with Almond Butter and Chia Seeds: Spread almond butter on apple slices and sprinkle with chia seeds.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of the fruit and nut butter wraps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested other nut butters to try besides peanut butter:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Almond Butter: High in healthy fats, protein, and fiber.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cashew Butter: Creamy and sweet, high in magnesium and copper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sunflower Seed Butter: Peanut-free option, high in vitamin E and selenium.
